newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL RUBBER ENDS SLIGHTLY DOWN ON CURRENCY CONCERNS.
newsitem.headline: KL RUBBER ENDS SLIGHTLY DOWN ON CURRENCY CONCERNS.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market ended slightly lower after drifting narrowly with buyers staying away because of currency uncertainty, dealers said.
"The currency could be the main factor which has caused many players to stay at the sidelines. The buyers are just watching the currency movements," a trader said.

"Right now there is no demand because people are not sure of the ringgit movement," a trader said. "That's why there are not much business. Dealers said demand could return after the summer holidays when the Europeans need stocks to resume their operations.
